name: sol-advisor
description: Quality-gated Codex workflow with bounded delegation, project opt-out, and total-cost routing.

interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor makes bounded delegation globally eligible unless the current workspace opts out, without requiring a child or route record. Task accuracy and first-pass completion are hard gates; among routes that preserve them, it minimizes expected total workflow cost across primary work, child work, result intake, verification, and retry risk. Spark handles compact frozen local production; GPT-5.6 roles handle investigation, synthesis, repeated mechanical transformations, risk-selected verification, and genuine adjudication. Context isolation remains a quality and cost mechanism, while the primary session owns direct tool lookups, design-dependent implementation, bounded evidence checks, fallback, and final integration.
defaultPrompt: Preserve task accuracy and first-pass completion as hard gates before considering delegation.
Consider a bounded child when expected total workflow cost falls or isolation or independent verification improves quality.
Use zero children when tools suffice. Keep design work primary; use one native final result, one correction, then fall back.
